# Another time: {{n-g|indicating a repeat of an action}}. {{defdate|from 14<sup>th</sup>c.}}
#: {{ux|en|I enjoyed it so much I went '''again''' the next day.}}
#* '''1931''', Robert L. May, ''Rudolph, The Red-Nosed Reindeer'', Montgomery Ward (publisher), draft:
#*: He tangled in tree-tops '''again''' and '''again'''<!--,--> / And barely missed hitting a tri-motored plane.
#* '''1979''', Charles Edward Daniels et al., “The Devil Went Down to Georgia” (song), ''Million Mile Reflections'', Charlie Daniels Band, Epic Records:
#*: Johnny said, “Devil, just come on back if you ever want to try '''again'''<!--.--> / I done told you once, you son of a bitch, I’m the best that’s ever been.”
|passage=The last sentence is so shocking, I have to read it '''again'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|We need to bring the old customs to life '''again'''.}}

#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=8|passage=The humor of my proposition appealed more strongly to Miss Trevor than I had looked for, and from that time forward she became her old self '''again''';{{...}}. Our table in the dining-room became '''again''' the abode of scintillating wit and caustic repartee, Farrar bracing up to his old standard, and the demand for seats in the vicinity rose to an animated competition.}}

#* {{RQ:Lincoln Pratt's Patients|chapter=1|passage=Thinks I to myself, “Sol, you're run off your course again. This is a rich man's summer ‘cottage’{{nb...}}.{{nb...}}.” So I started to back away '''again''' into the bushes. But I hadn't backed more'n a couple of yards when I see something so amazing that I couldn't help scooching down behind the bayberries and looking at it.}}

#* {{RQ:Allingham China Governess|chapter=19|passage=Meanwhile Nanny Broome was recovering from her initial panic and seemed anxious to make up for any kudos she might have lost, by exerting her personality to the utmost. She took the policeman's helmet and placed it on a chair, and unfolded his tunic to shake it and fold it up '''again''' for him.}}
# Over and above a factor of one. {{defdate|from 16<sup>th</sup>c.}}
#: {{ux|en|This stick is quite long, but that other one is half as long '''again'''. |q=''1½ times as long}}

#* {{quote-journal|en|date=December 10 1908|author={{w|Austin Hobart Clark|Austin H. Clark}}|title=New Genera and Species of Crinoids|journal=Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington|volume=XXI|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?id=uc7RAAAAMAAJ&pg=PA229&dq=again|pages=229–230

|passage=Cirri l-lxxx, 15, about 12mm. long; first two joints short, about twice as broad as long; third about one-third '''again''' [=one and one-third times] as long as broad; fourth and fifth the longest, about half '''again''' [=one and a half times] as long as broad;{{nb...}}.}}

# {{non-gloss|Used metalinguistically, with the repetition being in the discussion, or in the linguistic or pragmatic context of the discussion, rather than in the subject of discussion.}} {{defdate|from 16<sup>th</sup>c.}}
## Tell me again, say again; {{non-gloss|used in asking a question to which one may have already received an answer that one cannot remember.}}
## I ask again, I say again; {{non-gloss|used in repeating a question or statement.}}
##: {{ux|en|'''Again''', I'm not criticizing, I just want to understand.}}
## Here too, here also, in this case as well; {{non-gloss|used in applying a previously made point to a new instance; sometimes preceded by "here".}}
##: {{ux|en|Approach B is better than approach A in many respects, but '''again''', there are difficulties in implementing it.}}
|passage=A great bargain also had been the excellent Axminster carpet which covered the floor; as, '''again''', the arm-chair in which Bunting now sat forward, staring into the dull, small fire.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[back|Back]] in the reverse direction, or to an original starting point. {{defdate|10<sup>th</sup>–18<sup>th</sup>c.}}
#* {{RQ:Tyndale NT|Matthew|2|text=And after they were warned in ther slepe, that they shulde not go '''ageyne''' to Herod, they retourned into ther awne countre another way.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[in return|In return]], as a reciprocal action; [[back]]. {{defdate|13<sup>th</sup>–19<sup>th</sup>c.}}
#* {{RQ:Montaigne Florio Essayes|chapter=31|book=II|passage=So women are never angrie, but to the end a man should '''againe''' be angrie with them, therein imitating the lawes of Love.}}

#* {{RQ:Burton Melancholy|edition=2nd|part=I|section=2|member=4|subsection=vii|passage=Thus men are plagued with women, they '''again''' with men, when they are of diverse humours and conditions{{nb...}}.}}
#* {{RQ:Dickens Bleak House|passage=As he lies in the light before a glaring white target, the black upon him shines '''again'''{{nb...}}.}}
#* {{RQ:Bacon War with Spain|passage=There is not, in the world '''again''', such a spring and seminary of brave military people as in England, Scotland, and Ireland.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[on the other hand|On the other hand]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Richard 2|II|ii|passage=The one is my sovereign{{...}}the other '''again''' is my kinsman.}}
|passage='''Again''', it is of great consequence to avoid, etc.}}

# A [[composite material]] composed of [[ceramic]] and [[metal]] materials, used in such applications as [[industrial]] saws and [[turbine]] [[blades]].

#* '''2003''', Stephen F. Krar, Arthur Gill, ''Exploring Advanced Manufacturing Technologies'', [http://books.google.com.au/books?id=TGkfsC77pdwC&pg=PT73&dq=%22cermet%22%7C%22cermets%22&hl=en&sa=X&ei=HSugUui5CeKDiwLi2IDABg&ved=0CGYQ6AEwCg#v=onepage&q=%22cermet%22%7C%22cermets%22&f=false page 3-2-14],
#*: The multi-component alloy '''cermets''', made up of different hard materials and binder elements, have high wear-resistance qualities that result in long tool life.

#* {{quote-text|en|year=2009|author=Edmund Isakov|title=Cutting Data for Turning of Steel|page=114|url=http://books.google.com.au/books?id=QahG1Ou1cyEC&pg=PA114&dq=%22cermet%22%7C%22cermets%22&hl=en&sa=X&ei=HSugUui5CeKDiwLi2IDABg&ved=0CE0Q6AEwBQ#v=onepage&q=%22cermet%22%7C%22cermets%22&f=false|passage=Cutting performance of '''cermets''' was improved after development of titanium-molybdenum-carbon-nitrogen and titanium-tungsten-carbon-nitrogen compounds with binders containing nickel, molybdenum, cobalt, or a combination thereof (Ref 3, p.91).}}

#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=Bikramjit Basu; Mitjan Kalin|title=Tribology of Ceramics and Composites: Materials Science Perspective|pageurl=http://books.google.com.au/books?id=OxIY3UaaUroC&pg=PA356&dq=%22cermet%22%7C%22cermets%22&hl=en&sa=X&ei=HSugUui5CeKDiwLi2IDABg&ved=0CL4BEOgBMBs#v=onepage&q=%22cermet%22%7C%22cermets%22&f=false|page=356
|passage=Among various tribological materials, '''cermets''' are known for their excellent wear resistance under unlubricated conditions.}}
